general.label: Address
general.hint: the street address where the problem is, or the nearest address to that corner or block

general.label: When it happens
general.hint: the time or time of day the problem happens or was seen

crossing_guard.name: Crossing Guard Request
crossing_guard.route: A request for a school crossing guard at an intersection near a school, usually from a parent, or a report that the crossing guard is missing or not showing up.

fields.label: Request
choices: New crossing guard at this corner
Need a guard for more hours
fields.hint: what the person is asking for

fields.label: School name
fields.hint: the name of the school the children attend

fields.label: Time of day
fields.hint: when a guard is needed

fields.label: You are a
fields.hint: who is asking

street_light.name: Street Light Out
street_light.route: A street light or lamppost: light out, flickering, on during the day, dim, or a damaged or knocked-down pole.

fields.label: Problem
fields.hint: what is wrong with the street light

fields.label: Pole number
fields.hint: the ID number printed on the lamppost

fields.label: Location type
fields.hint: where the light stands

traffic_signal.name: Traffic Signal Out
traffic_signal.route: A traffic light or pedestrian walk signal at an intersection: out, flashing, stuck, or damaged. Not a street light.

fields.label: Problem
choices: Signal Head Turned or Knocked Down
fields.hint: what is wrong with the traffic signal

fields.label: Signal facing
fields.hint: which traffic the broken signal faces

fields.label: Causing a dangerous situation now
fields.question: Does the message say the broken signal is causing crashes, near misses, or a dangerous situation right now?

noise_commercial.name: Noise from a Business
noise_commercial.route: Noise from a bar, club, restaurant, store, or other business: music, crowds, deliveries.

fields.label: Noise type
fields.hint: what kind of noise

fields.label: Location type
fields.hint: where the noise comes from

fields.label: Business name
fields.hint: the name of the business making the noise

fields.label: Happens regularly
fields.question: Does the message say this noise happens repeatedly or regularly, not just once?

noise_residential.name: Noise from a Neighbor
noise_residential.route: Noise from an apartment, house, or neighbor: party, music, TV, banging.

fields.label: Noise type
fields.hint: what kind of noise

fields.label: Apartment
fields.hint: the apartment or unit the noise comes from

missed_collection.name: Missed Garbage Pickup
missed_collection.route: Sanitation did not pick up trash, recycling, or compost on collection day.

fields.label: What was missed
fields.hint: which collection was missed

fields.label: Collection day
fields.hint: the day the pickup should have happened

street_condition.name: Pothole or Street Damage
street_condition.route: Damage to the roadway: pothole, cave-in, sinking street, broken manhole or grate.

fields.label: Problem
fields.hint: what is wrong with the street

illegal_parking.name: Blocked Bike Lane or Illegal Parking
illegal_parking.route: A vehicle parked illegally: in a bike lane, double parked, at a hydrant, on the sidewalk, blocking a driveway.

fields.label: Problem
fields.hint: how the vehicle is parked illegally

fields.label: License plate
fields.hint: the vehicle's license plate

rodents.name: Rats
rodents.route: Rats or mice, rat burrows, or garbage conditions attracting rodents.

fields.label: Problem
fields.hint: what was seen

fields.label: Location type
fields.hint: where the rodents are

cb2.name: Community board
cb2.route: A neighborhood issue for the community board to discuss or weigh in on: a pattern at a bar or business and its liquor license, a street redesign, traffic safety at a corner (cyclists, drivers, or delivery bikes ignoring lights, speeding, failing to yield), development, landmarks, parks policy, schools, or a problem the city keeps failing to fix.

fields.label: Committee
fields.hint: which of the board's committees should review it

fields.label: Type of issue
fields.hint: what kind of problem or topic this is

fields.label: Business or project
fields.hint: the business, venue, or project the resident is talking about

fields.label: What you want
fields.hint: what the resident wants the board to do

fields.label: Wants to speak at a meeting
fields.question: Does the message say the resident wants to speak or testify at a community board meeting?
